messages:
samir: heads-up: launching config-only change in the 22:00 PT change window. cfg id cfg-8090011223. touching tinybatch.window, route.weights, and per-tenant idle_timeout. plan: 6% canary for 10m then step to 25% if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by samir — canary 6% for 10m across us/eu. Rollout id cfg-8090011223. Observability: https://dash/reports/cfg-8090011223. Commands: /deploybot pause <id>, /deploybot rollback <id>.

nina: Ack. I'll run smoke: 20 synths/region, check 5xx, 99p, kvcache.prewarm. Alert: auto-pause if 5xx > 0.35% or 99p > 760ms.

samir: Applied config: model.pin=v1.4-stable, tinybatch.window 50ms -> 32ms, routing.bias=new-replicas +6%, idle_timeout.background 15s -> 11s. Also enabled route.fallback for vip-tenants.

deploy-bot: Canary started (6%). Logs: kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/cfg-8090011223.

ops-bot: Metric alert at +4m: eu-west 99p climbed to 910ms. kvcache seed_miss increased for tenant-eu-pro.

nina: Throttling canary to 2% and pausing automated ramp. Seeing WARN kvcache.prewarm: seed_miss=0.35 tenant=tenant-eu-pro region=eu-west.

product: Noting customer impact: a few enterprise tenants in EU may see tail spikes. Fine to hold canary — prefer partial rollback vs full.

samir: propose partial rollback to revert routing.bias and tinybatch.window but keep model.pin and fallback route. command: /deploybot rollback cfg-8090011223 --targets routing,tinybatch --reason "eu kvcache tail"

deploy-bot: Initiating partial rollback (routing,tinybatch). This will keep model.pin and fallback.route intact.

ci-bot: Triggering kv prewarm job for tenant-eu-pro. Job id prewarm-8090011223. Logs: https://ci/jobs/prewarm-8090011223

ops-bot: Partial rollback completed at 8090011280. Canary paused. Summary: routing.bias and tinybatch.window restored to previous values, model.pin retained (v1.4-stable), fallback.route remains active for VIPs. Prewarm job started; monitor 99p for 15m before retry.

nina: After prewarm, we'll run a focused 5m smoke and then try a slow ramp (2% -> 5% -> 10% over 30m) if seed_miss drops below 0.12.

samir: copying release notes: "cfg-8090011223 — batch and routing optimizations; model pinned to v1.4-stable; partial routing rollback and kv prewarm after EU tail-latency observation. Held for retry tomorrow AM if stable."

product: I'll add the short blurb to the release doc and tell CS the plan. Marking this rollout as held for audit.

deploy-bot: Thread closed pending re-run. If you want to resume: /deploybot resume cfg-8090011223 after signoff.
